Briefing for 14 November 2026

Short items for 14 November 2026. Sapaude writes them in its own words. Where a longer article exists, the link goes there. The publisher is Sapaude.

Everyday tool

ChatGPT agents can now pay for purchases

OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet with Visa, Mastercard and American Express. Agents pay with a token instead of your card number, and you confirm every purchase with Face ID or a fingerprint; first for Pro users in the US.

Source: OpenAI

Long article

In the background

EU leaders hold their first AI summit in Dublin

At an informal summit, EU leaders discussed how Europe can catch up in AI while managing its risks. Commission chief von der Leyen put the investment need at €500 billion, from private money and the next EU budget.

Source: WELT

AI agents

Claude gets a plugin for factory software

Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing connects to tools like Autodesk Fusion, NetSuite and Infor. It drafts quotes, compares suppliers and writes quality reports for Team and Enterprise customers; key steps still need human approval.

Source: The Decoder

Device

Gemini smart glasses are open for pre-order

Google's glasses with Warby Parker, Gentle Monster and Samsung can now be pre-ordered in the US and reach stores on December 10. Gemini helps with directions, live translation and photos, and they also work with iPhones.

Source: Google

Long article

Everyday tool

Notion AI chats exposed in a vendor hack

A breach at AI provider Fireworks let attackers see some Notion AI chat transcripts, affecting under 1% of workspaces. Notion revoked leaked API keys and has contacted affected customers.

Source: Notion

Long article

Device

SpaceX plans $74 billion in AI computing sites

SpaceX wants to spend more than $74 billion on AI supercomputing campuses in Texas and Arizona. The Arizona site alone is planned at about $50 billion and still needs local approval.

Source: UPI

New model · More technical

Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small weights

Thinking Machines Lab put Inkling 2 Small on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0. The mixture-of-experts model has 594B parameters, 17B active per token, reads images and needs large GPU clusters to run.

Source: Thinking Machines Lab

Study

AI chatbots sometimes point shoppers to fake stores

In tests by brand-protection firm Podqi, risky shops showed up in 15% of Perplexity answers, 8% of ChatGPT answers and 4% of Gemini answers. Check the shop address before you pay.

Source: The Verge

Be brave. Get smart.
